passages.text: In the fifth month of that same year, the fourth year, near the beginning of the reign of King Zedekiah of Judah, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur, who was from Gibeon, said to me in the house of the LORD in the presence of the priests and all the people: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
passages.sermon:
King Zedekiah ruled Judah.
This was near the beginning of his reign.
It was the fourth year of his rule.
It was the fifth month of that year.
Hananiah was a prophet.
Hananiah was the son of Azzur.
Hananiah came from Gibeon.
Hananiah spoke to me.
He spoke in the house of the LORD.
The priests were there.
All the people were there.
Hananiah spoke in front of everyone.
Hananiah said, “This is what the LORD of Hosts says.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD says, ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.’”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַהִ֗יא בְּרֵאשִׁית֙ מַמְלֶ֙כֶת֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֔ה בִּשְׁנַת הָֽרְבִעִ֔ית בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֑י אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֡י חֲנַנְיָה֩ בֶן־ עַזּ֨וּר הַנָּבִ֜יא אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִגִּבְעוֹן֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֧י הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁבַ֞רְתִּי אֶת־ עֹ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃

passages.text: Within two years I will restore to this place all the articles of the house of the LORD that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon removed from here and carried to Babylon.
passages.sermon:
Hananiah was a prophet from Gibeon.
He spoke in the house of the LORD.
He spoke in front of the priests and all the people.
He said he spoke the words of the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel.
He said, “Within two years, I will restore all the articles of the house of the LORD.”
Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar took these articles from this place.
Nebuchadnezzar carried them to Babylon.
Hananiah said the LORD would bring these articles back to this place within two years.
passages.original: בְּע֣וֹד׀ שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֗ים אֲנִ֤י מֵשִׁיב֙ אֶל־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לָקַ֜ח נְבוּכַדנֶאצַּ֤ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ מִן־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם בָּבֶֽל׃

passages.text: And I will restore to this place Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, along with all the exiles from Judah who went to Babylon,’ declares the LORD, ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD makes a promise.
Jeconiah is the son of Jehoiakim.
Jeconiah is the king of Judah.
Many people from Judah went to Babylon as exiles.
The LORD says, “I will bring Jeconiah back to this place.
I will also bring back all the exiles from Judah who went to Babylon.
I, the LORD, have spoken.
I will do this because I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.”
passages.original: וְאֶת־ יְכָנְיָ֣ה בֶן־ יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְ֠הוּדָה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ גָּל֨וּת יְהוּדָ֜ה הַבָּאִ֣ים בָּבֶ֗לָה אֲנִ֥י מֵשִׁ֛יב אֶל־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י אֶשְׁבֹּ֔ר אֶת־ עֹ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃

passages.text: Then the prophet Jeremiah replied to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Hananiah was also a prophet.
The priests stood in the house of the LORD.
All the people stood there too.
Jeremiah spoke to Hananiah.
Jeremiah spoke in front of the priests.
Jeremiah spoke in front of all the people.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַנָּבִ֔יא אֶל־ חֲנַנְיָ֖ה הַנָּבִ֑יא לְעֵינֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וּלְעֵינֵ֣י כָל־ הָעָ֔ם הָעֹמְדִ֖ים בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “Amen!” Jeremiah said. “May the LORD do so! May the LORD fulfill the words you have prophesied, and may He restore the articles of His house and all the exiles back to this place from Babylon.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Jeremiah spoke to Hananiah, another prophet.
Jeremiah said, “Amen.”
Jeremiah said, “May the LORD do so.”
Jeremiah said, “May the LORD fulfill your words.”
Hananiah had prophesied that God would restore the articles of the LORD’s house.
Hananiah had also prophesied that God would bring back all the exiles from Babylon to this place.
Jeremiah said, “May the LORD restore the articles of His house.”
Jeremiah said, “May the LORD bring back all the exiles from Babylon to this place.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַנָּבִ֔יא אָמֵ֕ן כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה יָקֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ דְּבָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִבֵּ֗אתָ לְהָשִׁ֞יב כְּלֵ֤י בֵית־ יְהוָה֙ וְכָל־ הַגּוֹלָ֔ה מִבָּבֶ֖ל אֶל־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, listen now to this message I am speaking in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Hananiah was also a prophet.
Jeremiah spoke to Hananiah.
Jeremiah spoke in front of the priests and all the people.
Jeremiah said, “Listen to this message.
I am speaking these words to you.
All the people are also hearing these words.”
passages.original: אַךְ־ שְׁמַֽע־ נָא֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֣ר בְּאָזְנֶ֑יךָ וּבְאָזְנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: The prophets of old who preceded you and me prophesied war, disaster, and plague against many lands and great kingdoms.
passages.sermon:
The prophets lived long ago.
These prophets came before you.
They also came before me.
They spoke messages from God.
They prophesied about many lands.
They spoke about great kingdoms.
They said war would come.
They said disaster would come.
They said plague would come.
passages.original: הַנְּבִיאִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֧וּ לְפָנַ֛י וּלְפָנֶ֖יךָ מִן־ הָֽעוֹלָ֑ם וַיִּנָּ֨בְא֜וּ אֶל־ אֲרָצ֤וֹת רַבּוֹת֙ וְעַל־ מַמְלָכ֣וֹת גְּדֹל֔וֹת לְמִלְחָמָ֖ה וּלְרָעָ֥ה וּלְדָֽבֶר׃

passages.text: As for the prophet who prophesies peace, only if the word of the prophet comes true will the prophet be recognized as one the LORD has truly sent.”
passages.sermon:
A prophet may say that peace will come.
People must wait to see if the prophet’s word happens.
If the prophet’s message comes true, people will know something important.
They will know that the LORD truly sent that prophet.
passages.original: הַנָּבִ֕יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִנָּבֵ֖א לְשָׁל֑וֹם בְּבֹא֙ דְּבַ֣ר הַנָּבִ֗יא יִוָּדַע֙ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֲשֶׁר־ שְׁלָח֥וֹ יְהוָ֖ה בֶּאֱמֶֽת׃

passages.text: Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke it.
passages.sermon:
Hananiah was a prophet.
Jeremiah was also a prophet.
Jeremiah wore a yoke on his neck.
Hananiah took the yoke from Jeremiah’s neck.
Hananiah broke the yoke.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח חֲנַנְיָ֤ה הַנָּבִיא֙ אֶת־ הַמּוֹטָ֔ה מֵעַ֕ל צַוַּ֖אר יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַנָּבִ֑יא וַֽיִּשְׁבְּרֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: And in the presence of all the people Hananiah proclaimed, “This is what the LORD says: ‘In this way, within two years I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon off the neck of all the nations.’ ” At this, Jeremiah the prophet went on his way.
passages.sermon:
Hananiah was a prophet.
He spoke in front of all the people.
Hananiah said, “This is what the LORD says.”
He said, “In this way, I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar.”
Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.
Hananiah said the LORD would do this within two years.
He said the LORD would remove the yoke from the neck of all the nations.
After Hananiah spoke, Jeremiah the prophet went on his way.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חֲנַנְיָה֩ לְעֵינֵ֨י כָל־ הָעָ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ כָּ֣כָה אֶשְׁבֹּ֞ר אֶת־ עֹ֣ל׀ נְבֻֽכַדְנֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֗ל בְּעוֹד֙ שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֔ים מֵעַ֕ל צַוַּ֖אר כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא לְדַרְכּֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: But shortly after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke off his neck, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah: “Go and tell Hananiah that this is what the LORD says: ‘You have broken a yoke of wood, but in its place you have fashioned a yoke of iron.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
This happened after Hananiah the prophet broke the yoke from Jeremiah’s neck.
The LORD gave Jeremiah a message.
The LORD said, “Go to Hananiah.
Say to him, ‘This is what the LORD says.
You broke a yoke made of wood.
But you have made a yoke of iron instead.’”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֑ה אַ֠חֲרֵי שְׁב֞וֹר חֲנַנְיָ֤ה הַנָּבִיא֙ אֶת־ הַמּוֹטָ֔ה מֵעַ֗ל צַוַּ֛אר יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃ הָלוֹךְ֩ וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֶל־ חֲנַנְיָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מוֹטֹ֥ת עֵ֖ץ שָׁבָ֑רְתָּ וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ תַחְתֵּיהֶ֖ן מֹט֥וֹת בַּרְזֶֽל׃

passages.text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations to make them serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him. I have even given him control of the beasts of the field.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
The LORD says this.
I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations.
I did this so they will serve Nebuchadnezzar.
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
These nations will serve Nebuchadnezzar.
I have also given Nebuchadnezzar control over the wild animals.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹֽה־ אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֹ֣ל בַּרְזֶ֡ל נָתַ֜תִּי עַל־ צַוַּ֣אר׀ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֗לֶּה לַעֲבֹ֛ד אֶת־ נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וַעֲבָדֻ֑הוּ וְגַ֛ם אֶת־ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה נָתַ֥תִּי לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah, “Listen, Hananiah! The LORD did not send you, but you have persuaded this people to trust in a lie.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Hananiah was also called a prophet.
Jeremiah spoke to Hananiah.
Jeremiah said, “Listen, Hananiah.
The LORD did not send you.
You have made these people trust in a lie.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֧ה הַנָּבִ֛יא אֶל־ חֲנַנְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא שְׁמַֽע־ נָ֣א חֲנַנְיָ֑ה לֹֽא־ שְׁלָחֲךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה וְאַתָּ֗ה הִבְטַ֛חְתָּ אֶת־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה עַל־ שָֽׁקֶר׃

passages.text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I am about to remove you from the face of the earth. You will die this year because you have preached rebellion against the LORD.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD says this to Hananiah the prophet.
The LORD says, “I will remove you from the face of the earth.
You will die this year.
You have spoken rebellion against the LORD.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִי֙ מְשַֽׁלֵּֽחֲךָ֔ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה הַשָּׁנָה֙ אַתָּ֣ה מֵ֔ת כִּֽי־ סָרָ֥ה דִבַּ֖רְתָּ אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And in the seventh month of that very year, the prophet Hananiah died.
passages.sermon: Hananiah was a prophet.\r\nHe died in the seventh month.\r\nHe died in that same year.
passages.original: וַיָּ֛מָת חֲנַנְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַהִ֑יא בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃פ
